explication: Coze Studio is a visual, low-code platform for creating, publishing, and running AI agents, apps, and workflows. The main product journey is developer authoring through the workflow canvas and resource configuration, publishing an agent or app, then initiating a conversation and receiving a run result. Its README also identifies model management, prompts, plugins, knowledge, databases, memory, and OpenAPI as product capabilities. The graph follows the documented DDD architecture and tree paths; most backend implementation links are architectural-level, since the sampled source excerpts primarily cover frontend database-node behavior and storage interfaces.
